title: Comrades Start Information — 2026 Up Run start venue, groups and finish
claims: The official Start Information page identifies the 2026 race as an Up Run starting outside Durban City Hall, over 85.777 km, finishing at the Hollywoodbets Scottsville Racecourse in Pietermaritzburg.
The 2026 start groups were Group 1 at 05:00, Group 2 at 05:15 and Group 3 at 05:30, with wheelchair participants starting at 04:45.
The page lists a Start Map diagram for the 2026 start village; this is a start-area diagram, not a full-route map, and no 2027 start grouping has been published there.
The page does not offer a downloadable GPX or track-reuse licence; route geometry remains an official-link/unavailable item pending the 2027 Final Race Instructions.
